The '''Kosovar Mathematical Society''' or '''KMS''' (Albanian: {{lang|sq|Shoqata e Matematikanëve të Kosovës}}, '''SHMK''') is a [[mathematical society]] founded in [[Kosovo]] in 2008.
The KMS is based in [[Pristina]], and has been a member of the [[European Mathematical Society]] since 2012.{{r|ems|mactutor}}

==History==
The Kosovar Mathematical Society was founded on 22 August 2008 in [[Pristina]], the same year that Kosovo [[2008 Kosovo declaration of independence|declared its independence]] from [[Serbia]].{{r|history|mactutor}} The society was founded by {{ill|Qëndrim Gashi|sq}}, who served as the first president.{{r|mactutor}} Gashi later worked as the Kosovan ambassador to France.{{r|mactutor}}

==Activities and publications==
Since 2011 the KMS has coordinated the Kosovan entry at the [[International Mathematical Olympiad]].{{r|IMO}} It sometimes faces financial difficulties in doing so.{{r|telegrafi1}} The society does not take part in the [[Balkan Mathematical Olympiad]] for political reasons.{{r|koha}}

The Kosovar Mathematical Society publishes the Bulletin of Mathematical Analysis and Applications jointly with the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science of the [[University of Pristina]].{{r|mactutor}} The Bulletin is published in English, has been purely electronic since its founding in 2009, and is indexed by [[zbMATH]].{{r|zbmath}}

==Presidents==
The Kosovar Mathematical Society has had 5 presidents since its founding.{{r|presidents}}
*{{ill|Qëndrim Gashi|sq}} (2008–2011)
*Qamil Haxhibeqiri (2012–2015)
*Muhib Lohaj (2016–2018)
*Armend Shabani (2019–2022)
*Valdete Rexhëbeqaj Hamiti (2022–present)
